subsystems.name: Accelerator
subsystems.role: does the matrix maths that makes a language model respond in a reasonable time.

subsystems.name: Memory and storage
subsystems.role: holds the model weights in fast memory and stores model files when idle.

subsystems.name: Host compute
subsystems.role: runs the operating system, queues requests and moves data to the accelerator.

subsystems.name: Thermal and power
subsystems.role: keeps a continuously busy chip cool and quiet enough to live in a home.

subsystems.name: Inference software stack
subsystems.role: turns stored weights into a responsive service.
parts: runtime such as llama.cpp or vLLM

subsystems.name: Home integration
subsystems.role: lets phones, speakers and smart-home software use the model over the local network.

buildSteps.title: Set the target model
buildSteps.detail: Pick the largest model the box should serve and at what precision. A 70-billion-parameter model at 4-bit precision needs roughly 40 GB of memory before any conversation cache.

buildSteps.title: Size the compute and memory
buildSteps.detail: Token generation is limited by memory bandwidth, not raw compute, so choose a chip with wide, fast memory — a unified-memory system or a GPU with enough dedicated video memory to hold the whole model.

buildSteps.title: Assemble the hardware
buildSteps.detail: Fit the accelerator, storage and power supply into a small case with airflow sized for sustained load, not short bursts.

buildSteps.title: Install the runtime
buildSteps.detail: Install a Linux or appliance operating system plus an inference engine, then download open-weight models already converted to a quantised format.

buildSteps.title: Tune for the hardware
buildSteps.detail: Adjust the number of layers offloaded to the accelerator, context length and batch size until answers arrive fast enough for conversation.

buildSteps.title: Expose it on the network
buildSteps.detail: Run the API server on a fixed local address so every device on the home network can reach it without any traffic leaving the house.

buildSteps.title: Connect the home
buildSteps.detail: Wire the API into automation and voice pipelines for spoken queries and device control.

buildSteps.title: Maintain and update
buildSteps.detail: Refresh models as better open weights appear, and keep a small fallback model for when the main one is too slow.
